agent_explanation: Body 0 is initially stationary. Body 1 collides with it at step 26-27 at high speed (vx~27.7). The collision transfers ~30.6 m/s to body 0. Over steps 27-33 it travels to x~19.45, exceeding arena limit 20-r=19.198 by 0.25 (tolerance 0.15). Boundary collision fails to stop it; positional correction/impulse at the arena edge is insufficient for this numerically stiff high-velocity case, so body exits the arena.
